1.word_for_word: द्वियुक्-षष्टितमे प्रोक्तम् अनिरुद्धस्य रोधनम् । — In the sixty-second Dviyuk, the restraint of the Aniruddha is mentioned.; कन्यया रममाणस्य बाणेन बहु-बाहुना ॥ — He was enjoying his daughter with a multi-armed arrow.; अनिरुद्धोद्वहे\ऽन्यस्मिन् बाण-यादव-संयुगे । — In another battle between Bāṇa and the Yadavas, Aniruddha was married.; श्री-कृष्णः श्री-हरं जित्वा बाण-बाहून् अथाच्छिनत् ॥१-४॥ — Then Sri Krishna defeated Sri-hara and cut off the arms of Bāṇa.
1.translation: In the sixty-second Dviyuk, the restraint of the Aniruddha is mentioned. He was enjoying his daughter with a multi-armed arrow. In another battle between Bāṇa and the Yadavas, Aniruddha was married. Then Sri Krishna defeated Sri-hara and cut off the arms of Bāṇa.

5.word_for_word: पुराधिपं पुर-पालकम् ॥५-६॥ — the lord of the city and the guardian of the city.5-6
5.translation: the lord of the city and the guardian of the city.5-6

7.word_for_word: कामान् पूरयतीति काम-पूरः स चासाव् अमराङ्घ्रिपः कल्पतरुस् तं त्वाम् ॥७-८॥ — That which fulfills desires and that which is the source of all desires is the immortal tree of the Kalpa. 7-8
7.translation: That which fulfills desires and that which is the source of all desires is the immortal tree of the Kalpa. 7-8

9.word_for_word: हे आद्य ! — O first !; निभृतैर् भरितैर् दोर्भिर् अद्रींश् चूर्णयन् अयाम् अगच्छम् ॥९-१०॥ — I went to this place, crushing the mountains with my steady, full arms.
9.translation: O first ! I went to this place, crushing the mountains with my steady, full arms.

11.word_for_word: स्व-वीर्यस्य नशनं नाशनं केतु-भंगं प्रतीक्षमाणः ॥११॥ — Waiting for the destruction of his own prowess and the breaking of Ketu
11.translation: Waiting for the destruction of his own prowess and the breaking of Ketu

12.word_for_word: श्रीमहेशादिष्ट-सङ्ग्राम् अस्य प्रसङ्गम् आह । — The struggle ordered by Sri Mahesh is the context of this.; तस्योषेति । — Tasyosheti.; प्राद्युम्निनानिरुधेन तत्रापि स्वप्ने ॥१२॥ — Even there in a dream Pradyumna and Anirudha
12.translation: The struggle ordered by Sri Mahesh is the context of this. Tasyosheti. Even there in a dream Pradyumna and Anirudha

13.word_for_word: तं कान्तम् अपश्यन्ती सा उत्तस्थौ ॥१३॥ — Not seeing her lover she got up.
13.translation: Not seeing her lover she got up.

14.word_for_word: ततः किं वृत्तं ? — What happened next?; तत्राह---बाणस्येति ॥१४॥ — There he says, of the arrow.
14.translation: What happened next? There he says, of the arrow.

19.word_for_word: स्वप्ने त्वया दृष्टः एषां मध्ये को वा भवेत् ? — Which of these might you have seen in your dream?; इति देवादीन् यथावत् पटे\ऽलिखत् ॥१९॥ — Thus he wrote the devas and others on the tablet as they were.
19.translation: Which of these might you have seen in your dream? Thus he wrote the devas and others on the tablet as they were.

20.word_for_word: प्रद्युम्नं लिखितं वीक्ष्य श्वसुरो\ऽयम् इति लज्जिता ॥२०-२१॥ — She was ashamed to see Pradyumna writing that this was her father-in-law.20-2
20.translation: She was ashamed to see Pradyumna writing that this was her father-in-law.20-2

23.word_for_word: शोणित-पुरं नीत्वा ॥२३ ॥ — They took him to the city of blood.
23.translation: They took him to the city of blood.

24.word_for_word: पुम्भिर् दुष्प्रेक्ष्ये प्रेक्षितुम् अशक्ये ॥२४॥ — I am difficult for men to look at and cannot be looked at.
24.translation: I am difficult for men to look at and cannot be looked at.

25.word_for_word: स च परार्ध्यैर् अमूल्यैर् वासः स्रगादिभिः शुश्रूषण-पूर्वकम् अर्चितः सन् ॥२५॥ — He was worshiped with great service by offering him precious garments garlands and other precious objects
25.translation: He was worshiped with great service by offering him precious garments garlands and other precious objects

26.word_for_word: तया ऊषयापहृतेन्द्रियो\ऽहर्-गणान् दिन-समूहान् न बुबुधे ॥२६॥ — Her senses were taken away by her obsession and she did not perceive the days or the groups of days.
26.translation: Her senses were taken away by her obsession and she did not perceive the days or the groups of days.

27.word_for_word: आप्रीताम् अतिहृष्टाम् । — Unpleasant and very happy.; दुरवच्छदैश् छादयितुम् अशक्यैः ॥२७॥ — They cannot be covered with difficult clothes.
27.translation: Unpleasant and very happy. They cannot be covered with difficult clothes.

28.word_for_word: विचेष्टितं विरुद्धाचरणम् ॥२८॥ — They acted in the opposite direction.
28.translation: They acted in the opposite direction.

29.word_for_word: अनपायिभिः अपायो\ऽपसर्पणं प्रमादो वा तद्-रहितैः । — By those who are inexhaustible, there is danger\'s deviation or negligence by those without it.; पाठान्तरे दुष्टा प्रेष्या सखी यस्यास् तस्याः पुम्भिर्-दूषणं कुतो वेति न जानीम इत्य् अर्थः ॥२९-३०॥ — In another text this means that we do not know why men have spoiled a woman whose friend is a wicked messenger (29-30).
29.translation: By those who are inexhaustible, there is danger\'s deviation or negligence by those without it. In another text this means that we do not know why men have spoiled a woman whose friend is a wicked messenger (29-30).

31.word_for_word: कामस्यात्मनो देहाज्-जातम् ॥३१॥ — Desire is born of the body of the self.
31.translation: Desire is born of the body of the self.

32.word_for_word: अभिनृम्णया सर्व-मङ्गलया तस्या अङ्गसङ्गेन स्तन-कङ्कुमं यस्यां स्रजि तां बाह्वोर् मध्ये वक्षसि दधानम् । — He danced with her, all-auspicious, and placed her breasts in a garland between his arms on his chest.; मधुमल्लिका वसन्तभवा मल्लिकास् तद् आश्रिताम् । — The honey jasmine and the spring-born jasmine are the ones that depend on it.; तस्याग्र इत्य् आर्षः सन्धिः । — The tip of it is the Arsha conjunction.; तस्या अन इत्य् अर्थः ॥३२॥ — That means ana.
32.translation: He danced with her, all-auspicious, and placed her breasts in a garland between his arms on his chest. The honey jasmine and the spring-born jasmine are the ones that depend on it. The tip of it is the Arsha conjunction. That means ana.

33.word_for_word: आततायिभिर् उद्यत-शस्त्रैः । — The attackers with their weapons raised.; माधवो \ऽनिरुद्धः । — Madhava \'aniruddha.; मौर्वं मुरुर् लाह-विशेषस् तन् निर्मितम् ॥३३-३४॥ — Maurya Muru is a special lacquer made of it (33-34).
33.translation: The attackers with their weapons raised. Madhava \'aniruddha. Maurya Muru is a special lacquer made of it (33-34).

35.word_for_word: शोकविषादाभ्यां विह्वला अवशा । — She was overwhelmed with grief and depression.; अश्रूणां कला बिदवो ययोस्ते अक्षिणी यस्याः सा ॥३५॥ — The art of tears is the hole in the eyes of the woman whose eyes are.
35.translation: She was overwhelmed with grief and depression. The art of tears is the hole in the eyes of the woman whose eyes are.
